label: De Eendracht (1990-91, J.G. Suurhoffstraat / Haya van Someren-Downerstraat) terraced house: pale grey-beige brick over a dark purple-brown plinth, wide ground window and white door under a thin white string course, one small square window above, low eaves under a dark tile roof with a rooflight, mirrored pairs

band.label: grey-beige brick, white doors and string course

evidence.note: 2021-04 north front in shade, 72.5 px/m on the 4.83 m house between drainpipes (u from the window side): 2-light window 0.34-2.14 m, sill 0.9, head 2.41; door 2.97-3.86 m, h 2.4; thin white string course at ~2.6 m across the row; one small window 2.17-2.87 m, sill 3.48, h 0.75; eaves ~4.6 m; dark purple-brown brick plinth to ~0.6 m; rooflight near the frontage centre. Colours white-referenced to the white door of no. 27 (#6d6f6e): brick #606059 -> #d4cdb8 (brick-mottle k=3: tones within 4%, not mottled; drawn #d0ccbe, chroma reduced after the first contact sheet read tan against the grey-beige photo), plinth #312529 -> #5e464c (drawn #4f4347, less red)

notes: Roof: the north slope is only photographed in shade; roof-colours.ts reads the orthophoto #737373 (neutral grey, L 0.45) over the 60 placed houses, so the tile is drawn #64605c (dark grey-brown of the street view, lifted towards the orthophoto).
Eaves pinned at 4.5 m (roof.eavesPinM): 3DBAG eaves 4.45 m agrees with the photo, but build.ts rejects it against the 9.0 m ridge and would draw 6.7 m.
North-facing fronts, photographed in shade only: colours white-referenced against the white door of the same crop (exposure.ts). The roof tint was checked against the orthophoto with roof-colours.ts.
Dormers stand on about half the houses (many sizes and colours) and are not modelled: the design draws one rooflight per house. The brick storage sheds in the front gardens are separate BAG panden.
Deep houses (12.05 m: a rear extension in the BAG ring) get their own unit (sizeClassesM depth 10.8 m).
